title: Phantom Twist drone achieves near invisibility #PhantomTwist #invisibilitytech #droneinnovation
description: Northwestern University developed the Phantom Twist drone that becomes nearly invisible by spinning rapidly to exploit a flaw in human vision called persistence of vision. Spinning between 15 and 25 times per second, it blurs to the human eye, while a computer and AI model optimize its unique design of sparse carbon fiber rods for maximum invisibility. The drone’s single motor timing generates thrust to steer precisely during rotation, creating natural stability without conventional propellers. Out of 20,000 designs, the winning model is an order of magnitude harder to see than a normal quadcopter, revolutionizing stealth technology. While covert surveillance is an obvious use, its ability to remain unnoticed has exciting applications in wildlife observation and research, allowing for minimal disturbance of animals and new possibilities for environmental monitoring. #PhantomTwist #NorthwesternUniversity #DroneInnovation #StealthDrone #PersistenceOfVision #AIOptimization #WildlifeTech #SurveillanceTech #CarbonFiberDrone #SingleMotorDrone #InvisibleDrone #DroneDesign #AIDrones #TechInnovation #EnvironmentalMonitoring
